card.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
card.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful promotion. Your timing with the director's retirement was beautiful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And how considerate of the vacancy to arrive when you were ready.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm choosing the most generous version available this morning.
